author: Gamer247Carlos
quote: Terrible game. Overpriced, boring, chore simulator, no physical disc (you are effectively paying for a rental code), characters have no personality and are boring. It is a huge departure from GTA 5. I can't believe how critical could possibly give this a 100%, it just goes to show how removed from reality they are these days. I wonder how much rockstar paid them.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote: Story was dull. Gameplay/combat was repetitive and **** several glitches that were immersion breaking but not game **** game holds your hand at treats you like you've never played a game before (even on the harder **** overall vibe of wolverine felt off and not completely canonical. As a massive wolverine fan I have to say this is probably the biggest disappointment I've had in the marvel/X-Men universe. I really wanted to like this game.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
Absolutely terrible.
Story is predictable, characters are uninspired and i felt no connection to them. Gameplay felt dated, filled with cheap "jump scares" (like a flashed image on a screen with a loud scream at random points), just shows they dont know how to make a genuinely scary game and need to lean on cheap tactics rather than masterfully creating a genuinely scary scene/event. Not playing Alan Wake for what seemed like 80% of the game, was another weird aspect, it should be retitled "Saga Anderson: featuring Alan Wake". The mind place was cumbersome and unintuitive, especially the evidence board.
I could go on and on, but i don't want to waste any more of my life on this game or anything associated with it.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
I really don't understand how it got such good reviews. It's a glitchy mess even after the latest patches. I'm always trying to fix some in-game or quest bug.
Overall it pales in comparison to BG2 I blindly bought it with the expectation it would be as good as BG2.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote: What a disappointment! I've sunk 15+ hours into it and I don't think I will even finish this game, it's that mind numbing. This is no ghost of Tsushima. The story is boring, tired and predictable revenge tale. The gameplay isn't any better than Tsushima. Tsushima had graphics which defied the PS4 hardware limitations, Yotei made me wonder if my PS5Pro was stuck in the wrong graphics mode. I think this game is the definition of "resting on ones laurels", it offers nothing significantly new. The open world is disappointing. Not to mention the glitches I've experienced where Atsu will clip through objects or get stuck, I'm hoping patches will fix this.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
Terrible compared to the first game, another case of the sequel ruining the franchise.
I foolishly purchased this without even thinking since I enjoyed the first game, Big mistake. Never purchasing another Horizon game again...

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
I'm an Atlus and Persona fan, but for some reason a lot of the underlying messages were too on the nose. Also it lacked a lot of the charm of their previous games and I didn't form any attachment to any of the characters. It's pretty boring. The music from Persona 5 was a masterpiece! I actually bought the soundtracks! 
Persona 5 had me caring for nearly every character with their heartfelt stories. 
I really don't understand how metaphor got such high reviews.
This was a massive disappointment after having experienced peak atlus in the form of person 5.
I'd have to say this is one of my least favourite atlus titles overall. But it's still playable, just pales in comparison to their previous titles.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
I don't know where to start, seems janky, no power punch penalties, it's slow, it's boring and overall not fun.
As a technical boxing sim it is extremely flawed with unrealistic logic and no real genuine tactics other than cheesy spam moves.

Time to go back to UFC 5.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote: Buggy, slow, game breaking glitches, played 80% through the main and additional content but couldn't persevere to the end after my so many glitches and mission halting bugs. Got over it and not even that great a game when it actually did work...

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote:
Requires internet connection to even play single player (probably to control their microtransaction currency). Server has been down for over 30 hours, not allowing me to even play my own game on my day off.
Also it is pretty "grindy", hard to earn money, trying to force players into microtransactions

Worst entry in the series.
Game doesn't feel as open world as it should.
Lots of bugs.

author: Gamer247Carlos
quote: I bought this game with expectations of a 83% metacritic score. Boy was I surprised with this game. It is visually stunning, gameplay is amazing and truly is one of my favourite games of this whole console generation. GTAV being the only game rated higher for me.
